name: Hitodenashi
source:
Another personality that dwells inside [url=/c146472]Benio Matsuri[/url]'s heart that appears when Matsuri is asleep. Nobody sees herself as a shield that protects Matsuri from the cruel world.

She can be incredibly selfish, and her words, actions, and strong attitude cause her to come across as a haughty, ill-mannered girl.

[From the [url=https://hanakimi.frontwing.co.jp/en/character02/]official website[/url]]
